name: SAVA 萨瓦 Gelaro S4 / 越界 S4
why_interesting: The retained official-store Gelaro S4 GRX card is a second dated observation of the published SAVA Gelaro S4 GRX400 R21 build.
missing: Current domestic warranty route and final checkout conditions

facts.listing_identity: SAVA / 萨瓦 Gelaro S4 R21-GRX400-20S
facts.frame_material: R21 T800 carbon frame and fork
facts.frame_stiffness: Manufacturer qualitative lateral-stiffness claim plus independent no-noticeable-BB-flex report; no measured stiffness magnitude
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer approximate complete-bike claim for exact R21-GRX400-20S; weight varies by frame size and the page does not specify size, wheel selection, pedals/accessories, or weighing method.
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer publishes a qualitative lateral-stiffness claim. A separate PMKD long-term R21 S4/S6 review reports no noticeable bottom-bracket-area flex while climbing and useful stay compliance; these are qualitative ride observations, not measured stiffness. The review’s T700/press-fit description conflicts with the current S4 manufacturer T800/BBT47 specification and is not used to revise material or bottom-bracket facts.

source_note: The 2026-09-24 official-page recheck confirms exact R21-GRX400-20S, approximately 10.2 kg varying by size, T800 frame/fork, GRX400 2x10 hydraulic build, and 700x40C fitted/45C maximum. Weight remains an approximate manufacturer claim with unspecified weighing basis. Qualitative stiffness evidence is attributed to the earlier manufacturer claim and separate long-term review, not presented as an instrumented measurement; conflicting review material/BB descriptions are excluded.
